CCNL per i dipendenti da aziende del Terziario della Distribuzione e dei Servizi, Testo Unico 30 luglio 2019

notes.text: Salary tables: five tranches of the rinnovo 22/03/2024 (paga base dal 1/4/2024, 1/3/2025, 1/11/2025, 1/11/2026, 1/2/2027) taken from the official tabelle retributive as perfected by the Accordo integrativo 28/03/2024 (rounding fixes on Q, I, II, VI vs the 22/03 ipotesi), read in the signed text published by Uiltucs (pp. 63-65 of the 2024 PDF).
Seniority (Art. 205): ten triennial scatti; amounts Q 25,46, I 24,84, II 22,83, III 21,95, IV 20,66, V 20,30, VI 19,73, VII 19,47 (dal 1/1/1990, unchanged by the 2024 renewal).
'contingenza_edr' is the tables' 'Contingenza + EDR' column (contingenza frozen since November 1993 per L. 438/1992 plus EDR 10,33); 'terzo_elemento_nazionale' is the 2,07 EUR element of Art. 215.
Indennità di funzione Quadri 260,76 EUR (Art. 129, 14 mensilità; the literal sum of the increments is 260,77, the tables carry 260,76); VII livello 'altri elementi' 5,16 EUR.

Apprenticeship (Art. 53 TU 2019, unchanged in 2024): sottoinquadramento, two levels below the destination for the first half and one level below for the second half; eligible destinations II-VI (Art. 62); durations II-V 36 months, VI 24 months (Art. 64). Track 'livelli_2_5' (18+18 months), track 'livello_6' (VII for the first 12 months; the second half stays at VII by the general one-level-below rule, lexplain.it reads it as VI: adopted the literal text). Art. 68 Tabella B profiles with 42/48-month durations and the farmacista di parafarmacia derogation (Accordo 31/10/2024) are profile-specific and not modelled.
CNEL code H011 confirmed by Il Sole 24 Ore / INPS UNIEMENS reference.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: TERZO ELEMENTO NAZIONALE (Art. 215): 2.07 EUR a month due only in the provinces where no provincial third element is in force; paid when EmployerProfile.provincial_pay_element is false, left out with a missing_fact blocker when it is not stated.

SICKNESS (Art. 187): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay ('retribuzione giornaliera netta') without saying how the net pay is computed. The engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate (the 'lordizzazione' of payroll practice, Ordine dei Consulenti del Lavoro di Salerno) and tops it up to the measure of the gross daily quota; IRPEF is left out, as it falls on both. Day bands, carenza by event, the yearly comporto and the exclusion of apprentices are modelled.

limitation.remediation: Find a source (an interpretation of the parties, an INPS or Ministry text) that defines the net daily pay of Art. 187, align the computation, then resolve this limitation.

location.quote: il valore massimo della contribuzione a carico dei datori di lavoro, pari all’1,55% della retribuzione utile per il computo del TFR ... e quella minima dei lavoratori pari allo 0,55%

provenance.transformation: Employer 1.55% and worker minimum 0.55%, the columns 'Datore di Lavoro' and 'Lavoratore' of the table of the CCNL, employer 1.05% for apprentices (row 'Apprendisti'). The quota of TFR is the worker's choice in PensionFundEnrolment.tfr_to_fund.
provenance.note: Read from the PDF the url serves (sha256 e1604b50f245d34b4ea04aa53bb91056f55635b39b8c0935f31f2a79b578d40e), text layer; valid_from is the first day of the bundled tax year, the rates being in force since 29 November 1996. The base is the retribuzione utile ai fini del calcolo del TFR, as note (1) of the Scheda 'I destinatari e i contributi' states (https://www.fondofonte.it/statuto-e-nota-informativa/parte-i-scheda-iii-i-destinatari-e-i-contributi/, sha256 dc19e50af945d0671920bb1ebc77e5d75cc2a9dd2f6fd8cad5dd2882a66c8cb2). No human review recorded.

source_document.title: CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi, Ipotesi di accordo 22 marzo 2024 e Accordo integrativo 28 marzo 2024 (scansione firmata)

location.quote: il contributo da destinare in favore dell'Ente Bilaterale Territoriale è stabilito nella misura dello 0,10%, a carico dell'azienda e dello 0,05% a carico del lavoratore su paga base e contingenza, per quattordici mensilità.

provenance.transformation: Also: CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi (Confcommercio), Testo Unico 30 luglio 2019, p. 49: Dal 1° marzo 2011, l'e.d.r. di cui al comma precedente è di importo pari allo 0,30% di paga base e contingenza, corrisposto per 14 mensilità e rientra nella retribuzione di fatto, di cui all'art. 195.
provenance.note: The rate is read on paga base and contingenza, the first two columns of the salary tables (the CONTINGENZA_EDR allowance of each level): the observed payslip p17 (level 3, January 2026) prints 'retribuzione ente bilaterale commercio' 1981.84 = paga base 1453.94 + contingenza 527.90 and withholds 0.05% of it. The EDR clause cross-refers to 'art. 195', a stale number (retribuzione di fatto is art. 208 of the 2019 text).

location.quote: A decorrere dal 1°aprile 2025 il contributo obbligatorio a favore del Fondo è incrementato di euro 3,00 mensile, a carico del datore di lavoro. [...] l'azienda che ometta il versamento delle suddette quote è tenuta ad erogare al lavoratore un elemento distinto della retribuzione non assorbibile di importo pari ad euro 16,00 lordi, da corrispondere per 14 mensilità e che rientra nella retribuzione di fatto, di cui all'art. 208.

provenance.transformation: Also: CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi (Confcommercio), Testo Unico 30 luglio 2019, p. 102: per il personale assunto a tempo pieno, 10 euro mensili per ciascun iscritto, con decorrenza dal 1° settembre 2005; ... A decorrere dal 1° giugno 2011 il contributo obbligatorio a favore del Fondo è incrementato di euro 1,00 mensile, a carico del lavoratore. A decorrere dal 1° gennaio 2012 il contributo obbligatorio a favore del Fondo è incrementato di euro 1,00 mensile, a carico del lavoratore.
provenance.note: Employer share 13 EUR from 1 April 2025 (10 + 3), worker share 2 EUR; the observed payslip p17 (January 2026) prints 'contributo fondo EST' 2.00 and 'c/ditta' 13.00. The element is dated 'dal mese successivo alla data di sottoscrizione' of an earlier CCNL whose signature date was not identified: its valid_from is floored to the Testo Unico of 30 July 2019, before every period the bundle computes. The one-off 30 EUR of a first enrolment is not modelled.

location.quote: 1) 100% (cento per cento) per primi tre giorni (periodo di carenza); 2) 75% (settantacinque per cento) per i giorni dal 4° al 20°; 3) 100% ... dal 21° in poi

provenance.transformation: Art. 187 b): 100% for the three days of carenza, 75% for days 4-20 and 100% from day 21, stored as day_bands of the episode; the carenza at 66%, 50% and 0% from the third event of the calendar year as carenza_by_event; comporto of 180 days in the calendar year (Art. 186) as max_duration_days counted over the year. The measures are of the 'retribuzione giornaliera netta' (net_basis): the INPS share, free of contributions, is grossed up by the worker's INPS rate before the company tops it up to the measure, so that the worker's pay net of contributions reaches it; the company owes apprentices no integration and no carenza (apprentices_excluded).
provenance.note: Net basis, p. 177: '100% (cento per cento) per i giorni dal 21° in poi della retribuzione giornaliera netta cui il lavoratore avrebbe avuto diritto in caso di normale svolgimento del rapporto. Per retribuzione giornaliera si intende la quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art.208.' Apprentices, p. 178: 'Le indennità a carico del datore di lavoro non sono dovute nei casi di cui ai successivi artt. 189 e 195 né agli apprendisti.' The CCNL does not say how the net pay is computed: the gross-up of the INPS indemnity by the worker's contributions ('lordizzazione') is the payroll practice described by the Ordine dei Consulenti del Lavoro di Salerno (https://www.ordineconsulentilavorosalerno.it/files/2021/06/slides_zinno.pdf, 'la somma a carico dell'INAIL dev'essere aumentata dei contributi INPS'), not a norm; the open limitation sickness_net_basis records it. Quotes read on 2026-10-10.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded; no value was marked verified.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file (80 records) read again in the signed texts: the Testo Unico of 30 July 2019 and the renewal of 22 March 2024 with the accordo integrativo of 28 March 2024.
findings: 64 records match their source and are verified; no amount differs. Pages are PDF page indexes (the printed page of the 2019 text is one higher).
Wrong page citations corrected: Artt. 210-211 on p. 197, Art. 159 on p. 157, Artt. 186-187 on pp. 178-180.
The 16 contingenza and terzo elemento records match in amount, but no source states their valid_from 1993-11-01: they stay derived. No effect on periods from 2024-04-01.
The Fon.Te. rates are read in Art. 107 (and Art. 57 for apprentices) of the 2019 text instead of the fund's information sheet.
Not modelled: the two one-off payments of the 2024 renewal (level IV 175 EUR on 1 July 2024 and on 1 July 2025, 2024 text p. 50).
Pages 1-62 of the 2024 text are image-only and were read by OCR; the expiry clause of Art. 259 is illegible.

reviews.scope: P1 audit: the 16 contingenza and terzo elemento records left derived on 2026-10-11, and the tranche tables of pp. 64-65 of the 2024 renewal.
findings: The six tranche tables (1/4/2023 to 1/2/2027) print the paga base, 'Altri el.' and 'Contingenza + EDR' of the bundle for every level, with the same dates.

Contingenza + EDR and terzo elemento: the amounts were already right; their start moves from the unsourced 1993-11-01 to 2023-04-01, the first date a bundled source states them, and they are verified.
The renewal of 22 March 2024 (pp. 1-62 read by OCR) does not cite Art. 215.

reviews.scope: Registry check: CNEL code, name, signatories and term against the 21st CNEL report of CCNLs in force (30 June 2025) and the term clause of the text read in the P1 review.
findings: CNEL H011 matches (Confcommercio with Filcams, Fisascat, Uiltucs); the report also lists UGL Terziario as a depositor, not a signatory of the renewal of 22 March 2024.
Term: 31/03/2027 from the report; the first tranche of the renewal is 1 April 2023. The first paragraph of Art. 259 is unreadable in the scan, so the dates rest on the report and the tranche table.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'fondi sanitari, previdenza complementare, bilateralità e quote a carico di lavoratore e datore': the pension, health and bilateral contributions of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Fon.Te. verified in P1. The EBT (0,10% + 0,05%), Quadrifor (50 + 25 euro a year for the quadri), Fondo Est and Qu.A.S. contributions are not modelled: declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'fondi sanitari, previdenza complementare, bilateralità e quote a carico di lavoratore e datore': the amounts of the declared contributions, read on the full text published by a party.
findings: Fondo Est 10 + 2 euro a month (Art. 104, p. 101) and Qu.A.S. 350 + 56 euro a year (Art. 105, p. 103) read: the declared limitation now states every amount.

reviews.scope: Closure of the difference on the annual deductions of the observed termination payslip p25 (Terziario level 3, August 2026), shared with every CCNL of the terziario tax sector.
findings: p25 prints 1.621,58 of annual deductions, other_deductions 1.042,62 and 242 days (gg_detrazioni). The art. 13 deduction proportioned to 242 days is 977.62 or 977.63 (1.474,52 x 242 / 365 = 977.6267), the ulteriore detrazione 578.96, and the payroll adds the 65 euro of art. 13 c. 1.1 whole: circolare 4/E/2022, par. 1.2.1, p. 7, 'deve essere corrisposto [...] per intero nel corso dell'anno [...] senza effettuare alcun ragguaglio al periodo di lavoro nell'anno'. The engine proportioned the 65 euro to the days: corrected in irpef.deduction.rules.work_income_deduction.

divergences.subject: Annual deductions of p25: 1.621,58 printed against 1.606,30 computed by the engine before the fix (243 days, 65 euro proportioned).
divergences.cause: The engine proportioned the 65 euro of art. 13 c. 1.1 TUIR to the days of work; circolare AdE 4/E/2022 grants it whole.

divergences.subject: Art. 13 deduction of p25 for 242 days: 977.62 printed against 977.63 computed (1.474,52 x 242 / 365 = 977.6267).
divergences.cause: No source states how the proportioned deduction is rounded: the payroll of p25 truncates, the engine rounds half-up. One cent. Two payslips printed by other payroll packages, p26 (969.4658 printed 969.47) and p27 (74.9863 printed 74.99), round half-up as the engine does: the rounding varies by package.

reviews.scope: Checklist 'reviewed -> production': the health and bilateral funds left declared on 2026-10-15, the L2 values, the reference cases and the evidence of every total of the definition of done.
findings: Funds modelled as rules (parameters.health_funds), the owed limitation health_and_bilateral_funds removed: EBT 0,10% + 0,05% of paga base and contingenza for 14 months, or an element of 0,30% for 14 months (2024 text p. 12, 2019 text p. 49); Fondo Est 13 + 2 EUR a month from 1 April 2025 for the permanent workers of levels 1-7, or 16 EUR for 14 months (p. 17); Qu.A.S. 390 + 56 EUR a year from 2026 for the quadri, or 37 EUR for 14 months (p. 18); Quadrifor 50 + 25 EUR a year (p. 19). The 2015 declaration (10 + 2 EUR, 350 + 56 EUR) was stale for 2025-2026.

The fund records stay derived: pages 1-62 of the 2024 text are image-only and their quotes come from OCR, checked against the page image for Fondo Est and Qu.A.S. only. Two observed payslips agree: p17 (January 2026) withholds 0,05% of 'retribuzione ente bilaterale commercio' 1981,84 (paga base 1453,94 + contingenza 527,90) and prints Fondo Est 2,00 and 13,00 c/ditta; p04 and p70 print Fondo Est 2,00.
The EBT rate reads the contingenza, which the tables list apart from the paga base: ContractualFund.rate_allowances names the CONTINGENZA_EDR allowance.

L2: the INPS rates of the terziario are those the owner accepted on 2026-10-13 (allegato of INPS circ. 117/2022, FIS and CIGS of D.Lgs. 148/2015 arts. 29 and 23); the apprenticeship rules (Artt. 53, 62, 64) and every other payable rule were verified on 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-14; the TFR is statutory (art. 2120 c.c.).

Reference case commercio-confcommercio_3_2026_observed.json verified on the observed payslip p06 (sha256 9d1a08fccc56e5d1cf61ec795d7e6f6d0682d2ad997cab7fe69573f0efc45de8): paga base 1453,94 for level 3 in April 2026, a value the engine did not produce.

Totals: gross, employee and employer contributions, tax, net pay, TFR and employer cost are compared with the hand oracles commercio-year and commercio-june (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/period/sector), level 4, 50 employees, a provincial element in force; base salary and gross with the reference cases. The oracles recompute the pipeline from the same sources: only the base salary has an independent output.
Not modelled: the one-off enrolment fees of Fondo Est (30 EUR) and Qu.A.S.; the payment month of the annual Qu.A.S. and Quadrifor amounts, charged a twelfth a month.

reviews.scope: The renewal within the window of L. 199/2025 art. 1 c. 7 and the minimo in force before its first tranche.
findings: Renewal signed on 2024-03-22, first tranche from 2024-04-01: parameters.renewals.

Minimo before the renewal = the paga base of the table 'Paga base dal 1/4/2023' (read by OCR on the scan, p. 64); it holds the 30 EUR of April 2023 of the Protocollo of 12 December 2022, signed outside the window.
